gm.title: Description
lines: Once a dwarf, Fafnir turned on his family over the cursed ring Andvaranaut. He now guards his hoard in secluded hillside or cliff caves, moving whenever he suspects someone might find it.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Perception 15, Stealth 16. Darkvision 60 ft. and keensense 60 ft. Languages Common, Draconic, Dwarven, and Northern Tongue.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +6, Dex +6, Con +5, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha -1

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Armor of Greed (3/day). Fafnir can turn a hit against him into a miss. A critical hit costs two uses. Each use grants advantage on attacks against Fafnir through the end of his next turn.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Fafnir fails a save, he can succeed instead.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Bite attacks, replacing one with Constrict if desired.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing plus 11 (2d10) poison damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature is Grappled (escape DC 18) and Restrained while the grapple lasts. Fafnir cannot use Constrict on another target while holding it.
Misfortune Breath (recharge 4–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. Failure deals 31 (7d8) poison damage and makes the creature Poisoned through the end of Fafnir’s next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines:
Fafnir can spend 3 legendary actions per round, one option at the end of another creature’s turn. He regains them at the start of his turn.
Entrap. Move up to half speed and make one Constrict attack.
Toxic Blood Spray (costs 2 actions; 241 HP or fewer). Each creature within 20 ft. of Fafnir makes a DC 17 Constitution save. Failure deals 10 (4d4) poison damage and makes the creature Poisoned through the end of its next turn.
Inflame Greed (costs 2 actions). Cast Compel Avarice (Wisdom, DC 13) with verbal and somatic components, without material components or concentration. Choose a visible object and target one creature within 30 ft. On a failed save it tries to steal the object, fights its holder if theft fails, or flees the others to guard it once acquired. The effect lasts up to 1 minute. A creature immune to Charmed automatically succeeds.

gm.title: Lair Actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, use one option. Fafnir cannot repeat the same option in consecutive rounds.
Distracting Gleam. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each creature within 20 ft. of the point makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. A failure bars reactions and bonus actions for up to 1 minute, until Fafnir uses this option again, or until he dies. Affected creatures repeat the save at the end of each turn to end it.
Grasping Tentacles. Target up to three creatures Fafnir can see within 120 ft. Each makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or becomes Restrained by tentacles. Any creature, including a target, can spend an action and pass a DC 15 Strength check to free a target.
Treasure Whirlwind. A visible point within 120 ft. becomes the center of a 15-ft.-diameter whirlwind. Each creature entering it for the first time on a turn or starting a turn there makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. It lasts 1 minute, until Fafnir uses this option again, or until he dies.

gm.title: Regional Effects
lines:
The region can have any of these effects. They fade 1d10 days after Fafnir leaves or dies.
Avariciousness. Within 1 mile, creatures guard their things, covet others’ belongings, and have disadvantage on saves against effects that compel theft or taking an object.
Familial Strife. Within 5 miles, creatures become hostile toward relatives. Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion) checks to get someone to harm a relative have advantage.
Increased Mishaps. Within 1 mile, checks and saves to avoid injury while climbing, jumping pits, or otherwise risking an accident have disadvantage.

gm.title: Shared dread cloaker rules
lines:
Printed source. Cloaker, Dread, p. 51.
Damage reduction (Su). A cloaker draped around its host shares its damage reduction against physical attacks other than area attacks.
Engulf (Ex). As a standard action, the cloaker envelops a creature at least one size category smaller. Its host is engulfed automatically. Any other target requires a successful grapple check without provoking an attack of opportunity. The target is pinned. A cloaker without a host gains +4 to bite the engulfed creature.
Split damage from attacks that hit an engulfing cloaker equally between it and its victim. Area spells deal full damage to both. A shadow or undead cloaker can still strike other targets with its tail while engulfing a creature.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: Choose the kind of elemental and its size tier, then use that profile. All four use elemental traits and the Mists subtype. They understand speech but never speak. Free-willed dread elementals resent their conjurers and look for a chance to turn on them.

gm.title: Dread elemental rules
lines:
Printed source. Elemental, Dread, p. 63, and Mists subtype, pp. 7–8.
In Ravenloft, calling a standard elemental has a 20% chance of producing a dread elemental. Summoning magic always produces the dread form. Accidental dread elementals are uncontrolled, and the Dark Powers supply the matching materials. Intentional conjuring requires the matching material and uses the usual chance for the elemental to break control.
Dread elementals understand speech but do not communicate. Their Mists subtype makes them native throughout Ravenloft and allows them to be summoned in any domain. A dismissed dread elemental returns to Ravenloft itself, so the realm's restrictions on calling do not break the calling pact.

gm.title: Description
lines: A succubus has taken control of the printed fighter. It can imitate the host’s ordinary life until its wings and infernal features give it away.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium outsider (augmented humanoid), transposed 6th-level human fighter example

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. +1 longsword +13 melee for 1d8 + 8, claw +11 melee for 1d4 + 5, or shortbow +11 ranged for 1d6/×3.
Full attack. +1 longsword +13 with bite +6 for 1d6 + 5, two claws +11 with bite +6, or shortbow +11.
Smite Good (Su, 1/day). Add 6 damage to a normal melee attack against a good foe.
Spell-like abilities. Charm person at will. Darkness 3/day. Desecrate and unholy blight 1/day each. CL 6, Charisma-based saves.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 5/magic, darkvision 60 ft., immune to poison, acid/cold/electricity/fire resistance 10, SR 16. Dread fiends summoned into Ravenloft cannot return to their plane when the spell ends.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +7. AC +5 Dex, +1 natural, +4 chain shirt. Touch 15, flat-footed 15. BAB/grapple +6/+11, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft., Fort +10, Ref +7, Will +2.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Climb +7, Craft (woodworking) +2, Handle Animal +2, Intimidate +7, Jump +7, Ride +8, Swim +7. Blind-Fight, Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative, Mounted Combat, Weapon Focus and Weapon Specialization (longsword). Solitary, always evil, double standard treasure.

gm.title: Applying the encounter template
lines: A complete transposition replaces the host’s agency and changes the host to outsider. The host must be living, corporeal, nongood and Int 4+. Keep size, Hit Dice, BAB and saves. Add +1 natural armor, two claws and a bite, magical natural weapons, and flight at land speed (average) only if wings function. Smite adds HD damage (max +20). DR increases to 10/magic at 12 HD, SR is HD +10 (max 35). Modifiers Str +4, Dex +4, Con +2, Int +4, Cha +2. Increase CR by 1 at up to 4 HD, by 2 at 5–10 HD, or by 3 at 11+ HD.

gm.title: Template powers
lines: If Int or Wis is at least 8, gain cumulative Charisma-based abilities at CL equal to HD. At 1 HD darkness 3/day; 3 desecrate; 5 unholy blight; 7 poison 3/day; 9 contagion; 11 blasphemy; 13 unholy aura 3/day and unhallow; 15 horrid wilting; 17 summon monster IX (fiends only); 19 destruction. Default is 1/day.

gm.title: Possessing fiend options
lines: Balor grants see invisibility at will and fire that deals 2d6 per round to anyone touching it, with −4 Cha. Erinyes grants cause fear at will and +4 Cha. Pit fiend grants +2 Str and injury poison at Fortitude DC 27, initially 1d6 Con and then death. Succubus grants charm person at will and +4 Cha.

gm.title: Natural attack damage by size
lines: Bite/claw: Fine 1/none; Diminutive 1d2/1; Tiny 1d3/1d2; Small 1d4/1d3; Medium 1d6/1d4; Large 1d8/1d6; Huge 2d6/1d8; Gargantuan 3d6/2d6; Colossal 4d6/3d6. The full attack can use two claws and a secondary bite, or a weapon and secondary bite plus a claw if it has a free hand.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The book supplies Hit Dice but does not print a fixed HP total. Roll 6d10 + 24. The printed HP dice and initiative do not follow directly from the listed abilities and feats.

Magic Immunity (Ex). Immune to spells and spell-like abilities that allow spell resistance. Magical cold or fire slows the golem for 2d6 rounds. Electrical magic clears this slowing effect and restores 1 HP for every 3 damage the spell would have dealt. It can gain temporary HP this way and makes no electricity save. Only acid or fire can destroy it permanently.
Regeneration (Ex). It regains 1 HP per hour even while active. Below 0 HP it goes dormant and stops recovering. A strong electrical shock can wake it after its flesh is repaired.
Fear of fire. It tries to stay 10 ft. away from small fires and 25 ft. from larger ones. It takes a −4 penalty on Fear saves involving fire.

gm.title: Dread golem commands
lines: The creator can give commands from within 60 ft. if the golem can see and hear them. It follows the last command and responds to attacks against it. Some dread golems act independently.

lines: Climb +12, Hide +7, Jump +11, Listen +5, Move Silently +7, Spot +6, Survival +6, Swim +10. Alertness, Blind-Fight, Dodge.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any terrain in Lamordia. Solitary or gang of 2–4, usually neutral, no treasure. Advances to 13–18 HD (Large) or 19–27 HD (Huge).

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Use the printed 49 HP and +14 grapple. Treat the flesh golem’s listed vulnerabilities as exceptions to the general construct traits. The printing does not give a separate numerical multiplier for fire or acid.

gm.title: Description
lines: The maker shapes a body, but the dark desires behind the work bring the construct to life. Some dread golems develop wills of their own.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: Choose the material and use its member profile. The creator can give orders from within 60 ft. if the golem can both see and hear the creator. It keeps following the last order until replaced and defends itself when attacked. A free-willed golem can turn on its maker or leave.

gm.title: Construct defenses
lines: Dread golems are immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, disease, and similar effects. They ignore critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, energy drain, and death from massive damage. Their magic immunity blocks spells except where the chosen golem's profile lists an exception.

gm.title: Description
lines: This heading groups Ravenloft's living mastiff with two kinds of undead hound.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: Use a dread mastiff as a living guard dog. A trained attack dog can trip as a wolf does and a mastiff gets +4 on Survival checks to track by scent. A phantom hound normally guards its former master's property, but it will pursue a thief to recover stolen property. Phantom hounds that bay together use the pack version of Bay. Carcass hounds follow simple orders and attack the nearest foe until destroyed. Use the selected profile for its numbers and bite effects.

gm.title: Description
lines: A broad-jowled dog bred to guard property and hunt large game. A trained mastiff can bring down an intruder with its bite.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +2. AC 16 (+2 Dex, +4 natural), touch 14, flat-footed 12. Base attack +1. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +1. Listen +5, Spot +5, Swim +5, Survival +1. Toughness. Any land. Solitary or pack (2–5). No treasure. Always neutral.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Bite +3 melee (1d6+3).
Trip (Ex), trained attack dogs only. A successful bite allows a free trip attempt without a touch attack or an attack of opportunity. If the trip fails, the opponent cannot trip the mastiff in return.

gm.title: Traits and tactics
lines: Scent. It gains a +4 racial bonus on Survival checks to track by scent.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The print calls this form Mastiff under Hounds, Dread. It lists touch AC 14 and flat-footed AC 12 despite the AC components. The Base Attack/Grapple row gives only base attack. If you need a grapple modifier, use +3 from standard 3.5 rules. Trip follows the wolf rule cited in the entry.

gm.title: Description
lines: A black stallion whose hooves and breath flame in battle. A herd hunts in formation and may circle a victim before closing.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +7. AC components −2 size, +3 Dex, +13 natural. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 21. Base attack +8, grapple +13. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +9, Ref +5, Will +3.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Hoof +13 melee (1d8 + 5).
Full attack. Two hooves +13 melee (1d8 + 5 each) and bite +8 melee (1d8 + 2).
Flaming Hooves (Su). A hoof hit ignites combustible material.
Frightful Presence (Ex). Stomp and belch smoke. Affected creatures make a DC 15 Fear save or become frightened for 5d6 rounds.
Smoke (Su). In battle, snort a 15-ft. cone. A creature caught in it makes a DC 16 Fortitude save or takes a −3 morale penalty on attack and damage rolls until 1d6 minutes after leaving. The nightmare has concealment against creatures 5 ft. away and total concealment against creatures 10 ft. away. It sees through its smoke and can suppress it as a free action.
Trample (Ex). As the 3.5 trample action, Reflex DC 19 half. See the table note for damage.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Darkvision 60 ft. Etherealness (Su) works as the spell at caster level 20, with indefinite duration. It often retreats to the Near Ethereal during daylight.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Intimidate +12, Listen +12, Move Silently +12, Search +10, Sense Motive +12, Spot +12, Survival +13. Alertness, Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land and underground, especially Nova Vaasa. Solitary, pair, or herd of 6–10. Always lawful evil. No treasure. Advancement 9–10 HD (Large), 11–18 HD (Huge). Level adjustment +4 as a cohort.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printing omits the trample damage and the area for Frightful Presence. For play, use 1d8 + 7 for trample from the hoof die and 1½ times Strength, and use the smoke cone for Frightful Presence. Use the listed smoke penalty and concealment.

lines: Ravenloft's hostile flora includes rooted ambushers, mobile predators, and plants that use their victims as lures.

gm.title: Running the encounter

lines: The living dread treant sidebar retains the standard 3.5 treant statistics and abilities. The corruption of Ravenloft turns these treants evil and gives them a taste for humanoid flesh. Use the Undead Treant profile where the encounter calls for the separate, blood-draining creature.

gm.title: Description
lines: A wronged spirit wears straw and a pumpkin head to hunt down the people it blames.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +0. AC +2 natural. Touch AC 10, flat-footed AC 12. Base attack +2, grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +1, Ref +1, Will +3.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Slam +3 melee (1d4 + 1). Full attack. Two slams +3 melee (1d4 + 1 each) or one scythe +3 melee (2d4 + 1, ×4 critical).
Stinging Curse (Ex). A creature hit in melee must pass a DC 13 Fortitude save or attract a swarm of insects. Stings automatically deal 1d4 damage in round one, with another 1d4 added to the damage each round. Each round of stings also adds a cumulative −1 circumstance penalty to attack and damage rolls. The stings continue until remove curse or death.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Construct traits, damage reduction 5/magic, cold immunity, electricity resistance 5, and fire vulnerability. It understands languages known in life but cannot speak. Someone who knew the living spirit can recognize its changing face with a DC 20 Spot check.

gm.title: Skills and tactics
lines: Listen +2, Spot +2. It usually pursues its chosen victims and never retreats. Solitary, usually neutral evil, and found on temperate or warm farmland. No treasure.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dread troll stalks solitary travelers and bargains for a second victim in exchange for releasing the first.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +4. AC components −1 size, +4 Dex, +6 natural. Touch AC 13, flat-footed AC 15. Base attack +6, grapple +16. Space 5 ft., reach 10 ft. Fort +11, Ref +6, Will +5.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Claw +12 melee (1d6 + 6).
Full attack. Two claws +12 melee (1d6 + 6 each) and bite +7 melee (1d6 + 3).
Rend (Ex). If both claws hit one target, deal another 2d6 + 9 damage automatically.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Darkvision 90 ft. Scent. Regeneration 5 (Ex). Fire and acid deal normal damage. Lost parts grow back in 3d6 minutes. Holding a severed part to the stump reattaches it immediately. Alter Form (Su) changes its height to anywhere from 7 to 12 ft. Flexible limbs let it hide in tight spaces.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Escape Artist +6, Hide +4, Intimidate +6, Listen +4, Move Silently +6, Spot +4. Alertness, Iron Will, Power Attack.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land. Solitary. Always lawful evil. Standard treasure. Advancement by character class.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dread wight can pass for the person it once was until it gets close. Greater dread wights send their lesser kin into the fight first.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Any land or underground. Solitary, gang of 2–5, or pack of 6–11. Always lawful evil. No treasure. Common advancement 6–9 HD (Medium).

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +2. AC +2 Dex and +5 natural. Touch 12, flat-footed 15. Base attack +2, grapple +4. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +1, Ref +3, Will +5.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Climb +8, Hide +10, Listen +8, Move Silently +20, Search +7, Spot +8. Blind-Fight, Toughness. Dread wights have a +8 racial bonus on Move Silently, already reflected in the listed modifier.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Slam +5 melee for 1d6 + 3 plus energy drain.
Energy Drain (Su). A living creature hit by the slam gains one negative level. Use DC 14 for the later Fortitude save to remove it.
Create Spawn (Su). A humanoid slain by the wight rises as a dread wight in 1d4 rounds. It loses its former abilities and serves its creator until that creator dies.

gm.title: Greater dread wight
lines:
Large Undead, CR 6. 10d12 + 3 (68 HP), initiative +2, speed 40 ft. (8 squares), AC 20 (−1 size, +2 Dex, +9 natural), touch 11, flat-footed 18. Base attack +5, grapple +12. Use the printed 5-ft. space and 10-ft. reach. Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +9. Str 25, Dex 14, Int 13, Wis 14, Cha 17. Climb +12, Hide +10, Intimidate +8, Listen +10, Move Silently +22, Search +10, Spot +10. Blind-Fight, Cleave, Power Attack, Toughness. DR 10/magic, +1 turn resistance, and undead traits. Advancement 11–14 HD (Large).
Slam +12 melee for 1d8 + 10 plus energy drain, or make two such slams as a full attack. Each hit on a living creature applies one negative level, Fortitude DC 18 to remove. As for a common dread wight, humanoid victims rise in 1d4 rounds. A giant slain by the greater wight becomes a greater dread wight. It controls its spawn until destroyed.

gm.title: Description
lines: These shapeshifters feed on fear in the Veil of Sleep and use a dreamer's memories to decide what shape to take.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: A gray morph plays a minor part in the nightmare and flees when challenged. A shadow morph directs the dream and uses its howl to paralyze foes. An ennui stalks vivid nightmares and can turn invisible. Use the chosen form's profile. If a dream spawn kills a dreamer in the dreamscape, the dreamer makes a Madness save on waking. The DC is 10 + half the spawn's Hit Dice + its Wisdom modifier.

gm.title: Shared actions
lines: Alternate Form works as polymorph on itself at caster level 8 and takes a standard action. It lasts indefinitely, and the spawn can return to its own form as a free action. In its dreamscape, it reads surface thoughts as if it had studied each creature for three rounds with detect thoughts. Caster level equals its Hit Dice and the save DC is Wisdom-based. Once per day, Memory Drain inflicts 1d4 Intelligence damage with a touch. Until the victim recovers all the lost Intelligence, the spawn can mimic creatures from their memories.

gm.title: Lullaby and Fear Eater
lines: Lullaby is a standard action. Foes within 20 ft. make a DC 14 Will save or become fatigued for 1d4 rounds, or for as long as the spawn stays within 20 ft. and maintains its chant as a free action. This is a sonic, mind-affecting compulsion. Dream spawn are immune to fear, horror, and madness. A spell that would cause one of these effects heals the spawn 1 HP per spell level. If the spawn makes a dreamer fail one of these saves, it heals 2 HP for a minor effect, 4 HP for a moderate effect, or 8 HP for a major effect.

gm.title: Description
lines: These small spiders spin dreams. The pale ones bring rest, while black ones weave nightmares. Both communicate only through dreams.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +7. AC components +3 Dex, +4 size. Touch AC 17, flat-footed AC 14. Base attack +0, grapple −14. Space 1 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +2.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Bite +3 melee (1d2 − 2 plus poison).
Poison (Ex). DC 11 Fortitude. Initial damage 1d6 Wisdom, secondary damage 2d6 Wisdom. At Wisdom 0, the victim cannot be awakened until their Wisdom goes above 0.
Web (Su). It spins around sleepers within 50 ft. A light dreamweaver relieves Ravenloft’s nightmares horror effect. A sleeper free of that effect gains a full night’s rest in four hours. A dark dreamweaver imposes the nightmares effect while the creature sleeps near its silk.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Natural sunlight causes it to fade away permanently. It fights only when cornered.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Hide +10, Move Silently +6, Spot +2. Feat: Improved Initiative.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land or underground, usually in dreams. Solitary, colony (2–5), or swarm (6–11). Usually a colony has only light or only dark dreamweavers. Always lawful neutral. No treasure.

gm.title: Nightmares
lines: The victim is shaken for 5d6 rounds. Each attempt to sleep ends after 5d6 minutes, preventing rest, natural healing, and recovery of arcane spells. Each full day without rest adds a cumulative −1 morale penalty to attack rolls, saves, skill checks, and ability checks, up to −4. A sleep spell allows dreamless rest and clears the accumulated penalties, but the nightmares return on nights without it. Elves are normally immune. The optional waking dream during meditation instead works like major image and permits a Will save to disbelieve. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, p. 81.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The attack lines assign poison to the bite. The poison paragraph calls it a sting but gives no separate sting attack.
Nightmares refers to the horror effect in the Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, Chapter Three.

gm.title: Description
lines: This armored revenant tracks movement through stone and can retreat inside a wall.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Fledgling sample, 5th-level dwarf fighter. Initiative +6. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 28. BAB +5, grapple +11. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +3.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Choose slam +11 melee (1d6 + 6 and 1d4 Strength drain to a living target), +1 dwarven waraxe +14 melee (1d10 + 9, ×3) or throwing axe +7 ranged (1d6 + 6).
Terror Gaze (Su). Standard action to target a creature it can see within 30 ft. The target need not see the vampire. DC 12 Will Fear save. Failure by 1–5 leaves the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11 or more panicked. Fear lasts 5d6 rounds. Failure by 16 or more also prompts a Horror save at DC 7, the Fear DC minus 5. A further failed Fear save worsens shaken to frightened or frightened to panicked.
Blood Drain (Ex). Pin a living target in a grapple. Each round the pin holds, drain 1d4 Constitution and gain 5 temporary HP.
Children of the Night (Su, 1/day). Standard action to call 2d8 badgers, 2d6 wolverines, or 2d4 thoqquas. They arrive in 2d6 rounds and serve up to 1 hour.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
DR 10/cold iron and magic, cold and electricity resistance 20, darkvision 60 ft., turn resistance +4, and undead traits. SR 12 cannot be lowered. A dwarven vampire must overcome its own SR to cast spells. Tremorsense pinpoints creatures touching stone within 60 ft.
Stonewalk (Su). At will as a standard action merge into solid stone and travel through it at 20 ft. Remain merged indefinitely. At 1 HP or more, fast healing is 1 aboveground or 5 underground. At 0 HP or less it retreats through stone to its coffin within 2 hours or is destroyed. After 1 hour in the coffin it reaches 1 HP and resumes healing.

gm.title: Spawn
lines: A dwarf drained to Constitution 0 or less must be laid underground in a stone sarcophagus. The creator sprinkles the body with powdered metals. The victim rises 1d4 days later and remains controlled until its creator dies. At 4 HD or fewer it becomes spawn, otherwise a dwarven vampire. Dwarven spawn have DC 14 Fear Gaze, the same Strength Drain, Blood Drain and Stonewalk, and heal 2 HP per round only underground.

gm.title: Repelling and slaying
lines: Mirrors and presented holy symbols repel it. An unbroken line of metal shavings blocks it even through stone. It can enter only structures built at least partly from stone and earth. In sunlight it can take only standard actions and turns to stone the next round unless it escapes. Stone to flesh reverses this. Mineral-spring water burns like holy water and immersion in a natural spring removes one-third of HP per round, destroying it after 3 rounds. Natural stone through the heart kills it while left in place. To make the death permanent, the book requires the heart to soak in oil for three days, then burn to ash in a dwarven forge.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Appraise +3, Bluff +8, Climb +14, Craft (weaponsmithing) +9, Hide +10, Intimidate +2, Listen +12, Move Silently +10, Ride +7, Search +9, Sense Motive +10, Spot +12. Alertness, Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (dwarven waraxe), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Weapon Focus and Weapon Specialization (dwarven waraxe).

gm.title: Encounter adaptation
lines: Apply the strain to the 3.5 vampire template. Retain unmodified abilities, size, BAB, saves and skill points. The base vampire uses undead d12 Hit Dice and has no Constitution score. Keep an existing swim speed and ignore vulnerability to immersion in running water if the base creature can swim. Use save DC 10 + half HD rounded down + Charisma modifier unless specified. Age rows replace one another. Apply only to a dwarf. Age DR always requires cold iron and magic. The two listed fast healing numbers are aboveground and underground.

gm.title: Age modifiers
lines:

A rider can spend 5 ft. of movement to step into a free space within 5 ft. of the dymaxion. A rider exits automatically if forced movement takes it out of the dymaxion’s occupied spaces.
Magic Resistance. The dymaxion rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

lines: A cultist who can vary the element behind its attacks and move enemies from a distance.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Small or Medium humanoid, chaotic evil

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks, choosing Elemental Flail or Elemental Claw for each.
Elemental Flail. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 25 (6d6 + 4) damage. The cultist chooses acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder for the damage type.
Elemental Claw. Ranged attack, +7 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 22 (4d10) damage. The cultist chooses acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder for the damage type. On a hit against a Medium or smaller creature, the cultist can move it up to 10 ft. straight toward or away from the cultist.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Cast one listed spell as an action using Wisdom (spell save DC 15).
At will. Elementalism, Mage Hand.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Elemental Absorption (1/day). When the cultist takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, it gains Resistance to that instance of damage and gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

gm.title: Description
lines: An elemental lich fights up close to channel Ravenloft’s fire, mist, grave earth and blood. Its phylactery lies hidden beneath a mist-shrouded grave.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium undead (augmented humanoid), 10th-level human wizard example

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Touch +5 melee (see powers below), dagger +5 melee for 1d4/19–20, or dart +3 ranged for 1d4/×2. The touch and other natural weapons count as magical.
Conjure Dread Elemental (Su). Each day it may call one 8 HD blood, grave, mist and pyre elemental. Each serves willingly.
Fear Aura (Su). A creature under 5 HD that looks at it within 60 ft. must make a DC 18 Will save against fear. Success gives immunity to this aura for 24 hours. Caster level equals the lich's level.
Touch of Blood (Su). A hit deals 1d8 + 5 HP damage. DC 18 Fortitude or permanent paralysis and 1d4 damage each round. Remove paralysis or curse removal ends paralysis. DC 20 Spot or DC 15 Heal reveals the paralyzed victim is alive.
Touch of the Grave (Su). DC 18 Fortitude. Success means 1d8 + 5 HP damage. Failure means death unless heal is cast on the victim within one round.
Touch of the Pyre (Su). Hit for 1d10 damage, then clothing and armor save or ignite. The magic fire deals 1d10 each round until dispelled or the victim is burned to ash, typically within 1d4 rounds.
Touch of Mist (Su). No HP damage. DC 18 Will or the victim becomes chaotic evil and serves the lich, which can contact it telepathically up to 10 miles away. Remove curse cast by someone of the victim’s former alignment frees it and restores that alignment.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Sample DR 15/bludgeoning and magic. Immune to elemental attacks, electricity, involuntary polymorph, and mind-affecting effects. Undead traits and +3 turn resistance. It cannot control undead.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +6. AC +2 Dex, +5 natural, +3 bracers, +2 protection ring. Touch 17, flat-footed 10 as printed. BAB/grapple +5/+5, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft., Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +11.

gm.title: Spells prepared
lines: DC 15 + spell level. 0: detect magic, flare, ray of frost, read magic. 1st: burning hands, chill touch, comprehend languages, expeditious retreat, magic missile, true strike. 2nd: continual flame, flaming sphere, fog cloud, gust of wind, whispering wind. 3rd: dispel magic, explosive runes, fireball, slow. 4th: fire trap, remove curse, wall of fire, wall of ice. 5th: cone of cold, passwall.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Concentration +15, Decipher Script +10, Hide +18, Knowledge (arcana) +15, Knowledge (engineering) +10, Listen +18, Move Silently +26, Spellcraft +15, Spot +12. Combat Casting, Craft Wondrous Item, Improved Initiative, Scribe Scroll, Still Spell, Toughness.

gm.title: Phylactery encounter
lines: The lich buries its phylactery in a grave near the lair, where a rite calls mist over the site. Approaching creatures make a DC 18 Will save or wander away in confusion. Digging above it alerts the lich, which usually arrives in 1d10 rounds.

gm.title: Applying the encounter template
lines: Use a humanoid able to create the phylactery. Type becomes undead; keep size, BAB, saves and skill points. HD becomes d12, natural AC becomes +5 or remains higher, and Int, Wis and Cha increase by 2. Add one touch per round and the listed powers. Add +8 racial on Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Search, Sense Motive and Spot. CR increases by 2; save DC is 10 + half HD + Cha modifier. The sample carries +3 bracers, potions of invisibility and gaseous form, and a brooch of shielding.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Roll 10d12 + 3 because the sample does not print a fixed HP total. Keep sample touch and flat-footed AC despite the printed breakdown. The sample’s DR includes magic, but the template lists only bludgeoning. Pyre does not specify the item save category.

gm.title: Description
lines: This vampire veils its scarred face and retreats through living trees. Darkness and the underground threaten it.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Fledgling sample, 5th-level elf ranger. Initiative +12. Touch AC 18, flat-footed AC 15. BAB +5, grapple +9. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +5, Ref +12, Will +5.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Choose slam +9 melee (1d6 + 4 and 1d4 Charisma drain to a living creature), +1 longsword +10 melee (1d8 + 4, 18–20), or +1 mighty composite longbow +14 ranged (1d8 + 4, ×3). A target below Charisma 3 gains the book’s lost-one madness effect. At Charisma 0 or less the victim dies within 2d6 hours.
Wretched Gaze (Su). Anyone within 30 ft. who sees its face makes a DC 11 Will Horror save or freezes. The victim is flat-footed and unable to act until 1d4 rounds after losing sight of its face.
Black Thumb (Su). A plant touched by its bare skin makes a DC 11 Fortitude save or takes 1d4 HP damage per minute until it dies. This cannot be suppressed. Destroying the vampire ends the effect.
Spell-like abilities. At caster level 12, 3/day each entangle, snare, spike growth and warp wood. 1/day each antilife shell, giant vermin and wall of thorns. Save DC 9 + spell level.
Children of the Night (Su, 1/day). Call 5d10 hawks, 3d10 eagles, 3d6 wolves, or 6d10 HD of Tiny or Diminutive mammals. They arrive in 2d6 rounds and serve up to 1 hour.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 10/cold iron and magic, cold and electricity resistance 20, turn resistance +2, fast healing 4, undead traits, favored enemy (goblinoids +2, elves +1), Track. Plantwalk uses tree stride at will as a standard action and exposes both trees to Black Thumb. Alternate Form uses an eagle or giant eagle. As a standard action assume the listed animal form. Lose the slam and domination, gain the animal’s natural weapons and extraordinary attacks, and retain this form until the next sunrise or another change.

gm.title: Spawn
lines: An elf or half-elf who dies from the madness caused by the drain rises as spawn 1d4 days after burial. A victim killed by draining Charisma to 0 or less rises as spawn at 4 HD or fewer and as an elven vampire at 5 HD or more. The creator controls them until it dies. Elven spawn retain 1d4 Charisma drain, Plantwalk, 2 HP fast healing, DC 14 Horror gaze, and DC 14 Black Thumb limited to 10 rounds.

gm.title: Repelling and slaying
lines: An unbroken line of fragrant petals plucked within 1 day stops it. Music forces a Will save matching the Perform check or it stops to listen, with another save each minute. An attack ends the effect. Underground it takes 1d4 damage per round and loses fast healing and supernatural and spell-like powers. Between sunset and sunrise it must be in its coffin or can take only standard actions before being destroyed on the next round. Running water has no power over it. Fresh sap burns like holy water. A charcoal stake kills it while left through its heart. For permanent destruction, the book has its severed head burned with flowers and flowering shrubs for at least 24 hours. At 0 HP it retreats via Plantwalk and is destroyed if caught outside a tree for more than 2 consecutive rounds before reaching its coffin. After 1 hour in the coffin it reaches 1 HP and resumes healing.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Bluff +10, Hide +20, Handle Animal +7, Knowledge (nature) +9, Listen +15, Move Silently +20, Search +11, Sense Motive +11, Spot +15, Survival +11. Alertness, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot.

gm.title: Encounter adaptation
lines: Apply the strain to the 3.5 vampire template. Retain unmodified abilities, size, BAB, saves and skill points. The base vampire uses undead d12 Hit Dice and has no Constitution score. Keep an existing swim speed and ignore vulnerability to immersion in running water if the base creature can swim. Use save DC 10 + half HD rounded down + Charisma modifier unless specified. Age rows replace one another. Apply only to an elf. Age DR requires cold iron and magic. The Outcast Rating (OR) adjustment applies when dealing with non-elven vampires.

gm.title: Age modifiers
lines:
Apply one row to a base creature. The sample already includes its adjustments. Ability scores are listed in Str, Dex, Int, Wis, Cha order.
Fledgling. Abilities 4/8/2/4/0. Speed +0 ft., natural AC +4, turn resistance +2, CR +2. DR 10, fast healing 4, OR +2.
Mature. Abilities 4/10/4/4/0. Speed +10 ft., natural AC +4, turn resistance +2, CR +2. DR 15, fast healing 4, OR +2.
Old. Abilities 6/10/4/6/2. Speed +10 ft., natural AC +5, turn resistance +3, CR +3. DR 15, fast healing 5, OR +3.
Ancient. Abilities 6/12/6/6/2. Speed +20 ft., natural AC +5, turn resistance +4, CR +3. DR 20, fast healing 5, OR +3.
Eminent. Abilities 8/12/6/8/4. Speed +20 ft., natural AC +6, turn resistance +5, CR +4. DR 20, fast healing 6, OR +4.
Patriarch. Abilities 10/14/8/10/6. Speed +30 ft., natural AC +6, turn resistance +6, CR +5. DR 25, fast healing 8, OR +5.

lines: The ranger sample omits CR. CR 7 is derived from the 5th-level ranger and the fledgling’s +2 modifier. Its printed AC is 22 despite components adding to 23. Keep the printed AC, touch, and flat-footed values.

gm.title: Traits
lines:

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Sacred Weapon and Divine Ray.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 uses, regained at the start of the empyrean's turn. Spend one use at the end of another creature's turn to take one option. The creature cannot take legendary actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.

Smite. Make one Divine Ray attack.

gm.title: Description
lines: A winged jailer of the Veil of Sleep watches its prey unseen before attacking with four claws.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +6. AC 15 (+2 Dex, +3 natural), touch 12, flat-footed 13. Base attack +8, grapple +11. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +8, Ref +8, Will +9.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Claw +11 melee (1d4+3). Full attack. Four claws +11 melee (1d4+3 each).
Lullaby (Su). As a standard action, opponents within 20 ft. must make a DC 14 Will save. Failure fatigues them for 1d4 rounds or as long as the dream spawn keeps speaking within 20 ft. of them. Maintaining the lullaby is a free action. This is a sonic, mind-affecting compulsion.
Memory Drain (Su, 1/day). A successful touch attack deals 1d4 Intelligence damage. Until the victim recovers all of those points, the dream spawn can use Alternate Form to impersonate any creature from the victim's memory.
Alternate Form (Su). Use polymorph on itself as a standard action at caster level 8. The form can last indefinitely. Returning to its own shape is a free action.
Invisibility (Sp). As a standard action, become invisible as the spell at caster level 8. It can stay invisible indefinitely until the effect ends, such as by attacking.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 15/magic. Darkvision 60 ft. It does not need to eat, drink, or breathe. Detect Thoughts (Su). In an inhabited dreamscape, it knows a creature's surface thoughts as though it had studied them for three rounds with detect thoughts, caster level 8, Will DC 15. Fear Eater (Ex). Immune to Fear, Horror, and Madness. A spell targeting it that would normally cause one of those effects heals 1 HP per spell level. When one of its actions makes a dreamer fail a Fear, Horror, or Madness save, it heals 2 HP for a minor outcome, 4 HP for a moderate outcome, or 8 HP for a major outcome.

gm.title: Dream defeat
lines: A dreamer killed by this dream spawn takes a DC 17 Ravenloft Madness save on waking (Will). For consequences and recovery, use the Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, chapter 3. A spawn that wins often returns to terrorize that dreamer again.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Bluff +13, Disguise +15, Hide +10, Intimidate +12, Listen +10, Move Silently +10, Sense Motive +12, Spot +10. Alertness (bonus), Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Disguise). Speaks Oneiros and the languages of its current prey.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land or underground (dreams). Solitary. No treasure by default. Always lawful evil. Advances at 9–16 HD (Medium) or 17–24 HD (Large). An ennui sometimes carries a dreamslayer weapon. While dreaming, add +3 to that weapon's existing enhancement bonus, to a maximum of +5. Outside of dreams, use the weapon's normal enhancement bonus.

gm.title: Traits
lines:

Web Sense. When it touches a web, it knows the location of any other creature touching the same web.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A cat-sized dragon with butterfly wings. Older forms range from green through blue and indigo to violet.

gm.title: Attacks
lines: Bite · melee · +7 to hit · reach 5 ft. · 1 piercing

gm.title: Variant rules
lines: Superior Invisibility is a bonus action and requires Concentration. Worn and carried gear also becomes Invisible.

Euphoria Breath (Recharge 5–6) targets one creature within 5 ft. It must pass a DC 11 Wisdom save or lose reactions for 1 minute. At each turn start roll a d6. On 1–4 it takes no action or bonus action and uses all its movement in a random direction. On 5–6 it stays still and can only repeat the save to end the effect.

gm.title: Faerie Dragon Color and Age
lines: Age by color. Red up to 5 years, orange 6–10, yellow 11–20, green 21–30, blue 31–40, indigo 41–50, and violet 51 or more.

Each spell is usable once per day. Red gains Dancing Lights, Mage Hand and Minor Illusion. Orange adds Color Spray and yellow adds Mirror Image. Green adds Suggestion, blue Major Image, indigo Hallucinatory Terrain and violet Polymorph. Each color keeps all spells of younger colors.
Red through yellow are CR 1. Green through violet are CR 2. Innate spell save DC 13.

gm.title: Description
lines: Far traders sail the Astral Sea to sell luxury goods and magic-infused stones. Their hidden home port is the black-rock city of Far Spire.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Studded leather. Perception 15, Stealth 12. Vulnerable to radiant damage and resistant to necrotic damage. Darkvision 120 ft. Speaks all languages.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +1, Dex +2, Con +4, Int +3, Wis +5, Cha +6

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Astral Seafarer. Proficient with airships and waterborne vessels. Add its proficiency bonus to checks to control such a vessel and grant advantage on saves made aboard.
Ethereal Sight. See 60 ft. across the boundary between the Material and Ethereal Planes from either side.
Far Traveler. Advantage on saves against environmental dangers such as Void terrain and infernal gases.
Phrenic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical and add 2d4 psychic damage on a hit, included below.
Regeneration. Regain 2 HP at the start of each turn. Fire or radiant damage disables this trait at the start of its next turn. The trader dies only if it starts a turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
Trader’s Eye. Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks to spot defective or counterfeit goods and on Wisdom (Insight) checks to catch someone trying to sell those goods.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Scimitar or Psychic Bolt attacks. The trader can replace one with Spellcasting.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) psychic damage.
Psychic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d4 + 4) psychic damage.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines: Charisma, save DC 14. At will: Message, Minor Illusion. Three times per day each: Disguise Self, Suggestion.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines:
Etherealness. Switch between the Material and Ethereal Planes. The trader remains visible from the other plane, but cannot affect or be affected by anything there.
Trader’s Jargon. One creature the trader can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Charisma save. On a failure, it is vulnerable to psychic damage until the end of its next turn.

lines:
Rules source. Black Flag Reference Document, Monsters.

Condition resistance gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end the named condition. Condition vulnerability gives disadvantage. Apply damage resistance and vulnerability to the amount of damage instead.

gm.title: Description
lines: This milkweed look-alike feeds when its hallucination-inducing pollen turns travelers against one another.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Any land. Patch of 11–20. Always neutral. Standard treasure.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +0. AC includes +2 size, touch and flat-footed 12. Base attack and grapple +0. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +5, Ref +0, Will −1.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Plant traits. Tremorsense locates creatures and objects touching the ground within 60 ft. Camouflage (Ex). Spot, Survival, or Knowledge (plants or herbs) DC 20 to identify the plant before it attacks.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
No ordinary attack.
Fear Pollen (Su, 1/day). Movement within 20 ft. triggers a 20-ft.-radius cloud centered on the plant. It lasts 1d3 minutes. Each round in the cloud, make a DC 13 Fortitude save or suffer paranoia and threatening hallucinations for 1d4 minutes. If an affected victim dies or falls unconscious, each of that victim's companions can make another Fortitude save. Success restores control, with a −2 penalty on attacks, checks, and saves for the remaining duration. Immunity to poison or mind-affecting effects prevents this effect. Neutralize poison ends it.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The second Fortitude save has no separate DC in print. Use the initial DC 13 for that save.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Wizards of the Coast and Green Ronin Publishing, Out of the Abyss, first printing, September 2015, Appendix C, Creatures, Steeders, p. 231. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/17401-female-steeder

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Spider Climb. The steeder climbs difficult surfaces and crosses ceilings upside down without an ability check.
Leap. If its speed is at least 30 ft., the steeder can spend all its movement for the turn to jump up to 90 ft. vertically or horizontally.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5 ft. reach, one creature. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage and calls for a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 9 (2d8) acid damage on a failure or half on a success.
Sticky Leg. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5 ft. reach, one Medium or smaller creature. A hit sticks the creature to a leg and grapples it until it escapes, DC 12. The action recharges when the steeder has no creatures grappled.

gm.title: Encounter ecology
lines: Duergar use the larger female steeders as mounts. The animals grip walls, ceilings, and prey with a sticky secretion from their legs.

gm.title: Encounter placement
lines: When a Duergar Kavalrachni hits with a melee attack while riding a female steeder, the steeder can use its reaction to make a melee attack against the same target.

gm.title: Source notes
lines: Appendix C p. 231 gives a Large Beast. The encounter-specific Cavalry Training on p. 226 belongs to the Duergar Kavalrachni rider.

gm.title: Description
lines: At the full moon, these golden marsh hounds track someone who has committed a deed that calls for a powers check.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Temperate marsh. Pair or pack of 5–8. Always chaotic good. No treasure. Advancement 6–10 HD (Large). No level adjustment listed.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +2. AC +2 Dex and +6 natural, touch 12, flat-footed 16. Base attack +4, grapple +8. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +6, Ref +6, Will +4.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Listen +7, Move Silently +9, Spot +7, Survival +7. Endurance, Track.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Damage reduction 5/—, scent, spell resistance 14. Magic Immunity (Ex). Immune to Sun domain spells. Spells cast by priests of deities of the moon, moors, or revenge cannot harm it.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Bite +8 melee (1d8 + 4).
Trip (Ex). After a bite hits, make a trip check at +4 as a free action. No touch attack or attack of opportunity, and the target cannot counter-trip on a failure.
Bay (Su). At the start of the hunt its howl carries one mile. The quarry must immediately attempt a DC 13 Fear save if it hears the bay.

gm.title: The hunt
lines: A deed requiring a powers check in a swamp or moor draws at least two hounds on the next full moon. They track the quarry unerringly, fight anyone who interferes, and vanish at dawn. They return on the three nights of a full moon while the quarry survives and the curse remains. A slain hound dissolves into luminous vapor. Recurrence (Su). Killing a fenhound makes the killer the target of a pack at each full moon. Atonement ends the pursuit.

gm.title: Ravenloft Fear
lines: When using the Ravenloft Fear rules, roll a Will save. Apply modifiers to saves against fear. Failure by 1–5 makes the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11–15 panicked. Failure by 16 or more makes it panicked and calls for an immediate Horror save at the Fear DC minus 5. Fear lasts 5d6 rounds. A second failure escalates shaken to frightened or frightened to panicked. Creatures without Intelligence scores are immune. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, pp. 77–79.

gm.title: Description
lines: A wolf twisted by Fenris that fights with a chain it can move at will. Breaking the chain leaves it stunned and limits it to its bite.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Perception 18, Stealth 12. Immune to cold damage and Frightened. Darkvision 90 ft. Understands Abyssal and Giant without speaking.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +6, Int -2, Wis +5, Cha -2

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Monstrosity Resilience. The printed trait grants resistance to Exhaustion and Frightened. The stat line grants immunity to Frightened.
Mystical Chain. Attack the chain at AC 17 and deal 20 slashing damage to cut it without hurting the fenrikyn with that attack. Severing it deals 18 (4d8) psychic damage to the fenrikyn, Stuns it until the end of its next turn, and disables Chain, Whirling Chain, and Deflecting Chain.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Chain attack. If the chain is broken, make two Bite attacks instead.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 23 (4d8 + 5) piercing damage.
Chain. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit 19 (4d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller target is also Grappled (escape DC 16). While held, it cannot move farther than 20 ft. from the fenrikyn and its speed drops by 10 ft.
Whirling Chain (Recharge 6). Each creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and the fenrikyn pushes or pulls it 10 ft. Success halves the damage and prevents the movement.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Deflecting Chain. When an attack hits, add 3 to AC against it, which can turn the hit into a miss.

gm.title: Description
lines: Rajian artisans animate small statues as guards, assassins, and distractions. The material determines how each construct fights.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: Choose a figurine by its material. A Ceramic Figurine sprays stored liquids. A Crystal Figurine uses patterned lights and reflects light spells. An Ivory Figurine grows to elephant size. An Obsidian Figurine gets underfoot and sprays sharp fragments when hit. A Porcelain Figurine uses enervation rays and grows to tiger size.

gm.title: Control
lines: Once a month, the figurine and its master make opposed Will saves. A win frees the figurine, changes its moral alignment to evil, and sends it after its former master. Figurines understand their creator's language and cannot speak.

gm.title: Description
lines: Fire giant foundries put their strongest workers to use moving coal and ore. In battle, a dreadnought fills its two spiked shields with hot coals and drives forward behind them.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Dual Shields. The pair grants a total +3 bonus to AC, already included in the giant's AC.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Fireshield and Rock.
Fireshield. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (4d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage, 7 (2d6) fire damage, and 7 (2d6) piercing damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
Shield Charge (Recharge 5–6). Move up to 30 ft. in a straight line. The giant can pass through the spaces of creatures smaller than Huge. The first time it enters each creature's space during the move, that creature makes a DC 21 Strength save. On a failure, the creature takes 36 (8d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and 14 (4d6) fire damage, is pushed up to 30 ft., and falls prone.

lines: Natural armor. Saves Str +10, Dex +7, and Con +10. Athletics +10, Perception +9. Immune to fire damage. Passive Perception 19. Speaks Giant.

lines:
Healing Heat. When a fire giant is the target of the lightbearer’s attack, spell, or other supernatural effect that deals fire damage, roll the fire damage and restore that many HP to the target instead. The target can choose to let the attack hit or to fail the save.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

lines: A blood sovereign can find living creatures through obscured sight and replenish its strength with each spear hit.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Large Elemental (Earth, Fire, Water), any alignment

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saves Con +12, Wis +10, Cha +11. Intimidation +11, Medicine +10, Persuasion +11. Resists fire and necrotic damage. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, and Frightened. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 14. Speaks Common, Dwarvish, Elvish, Giant, and Primordial.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Visceral Sight. See any creature within 120 ft. other than a Construct or an Undead. Effects that obscure sight do not block this sense.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Scarlet Longspear attacks. One can be replaced with Rend from Within.
Scarlet Longspear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage. The force of blood regains 5 HP if it hits a creature.
Rend from Within. Melee spell attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 26 (4d12) necrotic damage. The target spends one Hit Die without effect and cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn. Miss 13 (2d12) necrotic damage.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines:
Convocation of Blood. Choose the force of blood or another visible Elemental within 30 ft. That Elemental chooses Boiling Blood or Essence Thief.
Boiling Blood. A creature within 5 ft. of the Elemental, other than a Construct or an Undead, makes a DC 19 Constitution save. On a failure it chooses between taking 27 (5d10) fire damage or attacking a creature the Elemental picks with a weapon whose damage die is at least 1d4. The attack deals an extra 11 (2d10) fire damage on a hit.
Essence Thief. Two creatures the Elemental sees within 30 ft. make DC 19 Constitution saves, taking 19 (3d12) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The Elemental can then teleport to a visible unoccupied space within 5 ft. of either target.

gm.title: Description
lines: The Prince of Deception recruits mortals under false identities. He sends his servants to find the scattered pieces of the staff taken from him during his imprisonment beneath Castle Greyhawk.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Poison. Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). After failing a save, Fraz-Urb’luu can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. He has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Undetectable. Divination magic cannot target him. Magical scrying sensors cannot perceive him, and abilities that sense demons or fiends cannot detect him.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Fist attacks, and use Phantasmal Terror.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d6 + 9) force damage.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (3d8 + 9) force damage.
Phantasmal Terror. Choose one visible creature within 120 ft. On a failed DC 23 Wisdom save, it takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage and is frightened of Fraz-Urb’luu until the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 23). No material components are required.
At will. Alter Self, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, and Phantasmal Force. Alter Self can make him Medium when he uses its appearance option.
3/day each. Mislead, Programmed Illusion, and Seeming.
1/day each. Modify Memory and Project Image.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Fraz-Urb’luu has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of his turn. He can choose one option immediately after another creature finishes its turn. He loses access to these actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using one.
Tail (1 action). Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) force damage. A Large or smaller creature is also grappled (escape DC 24) and remains restrained for the duration of the grapple. His tail can grapple only one creature at a time.
Terror (2 actions). Use Phantasmal Terror.

gm.title: Lair
lines: Fraz-Urb’luu lairs in the fortress city of Zoragmelok in Hollow’s Heart. In his lair he is CR 24 (62,000 XP).

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, after anyone tied at 20, choose one action while Fraz-Urb’luu is in his lair. He cannot repeat an option in consecutive rounds. He must be able to act and, if surprised, must finish his first turn before using a lair action.
Conjure Walls and Doors. Turn up to five doors in the lair into walls and open an equal number of new doors in walls that had none.
Psychic Anguish. Every creature he can see in the lair makes a DC 23 Wisdom save, taking 33 (6d10) psychic damage on a failure.
Simulacrum. Pick one humanoid in the lair and instantly make a duplicate as with the Simulacrum spell. The duplicate obeys him and is destroyed at the next initiative count 20.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more of these effects for the area surrounding the lair.
Beguiling Realm. Within 6 miles, Charisma (Persuasion) and Wisdom (Insight) checks have disadvantage. Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Performance) checks have advantage.
Nostalgic Pangs. Within 1 mile, sapient creatures often catch brief glimpses of long-dead friends or companions.
Twisted Paths. Within 6 miles, roads and trails bend back on themselves and make navigation difficult.
If Fraz-Urb’luu dies, the effects fade over 1d10 days.

gm.title: Description
lines: The demon lord of illusions wears false identities even when dealing with his own cultists. He looks like a long-necked, winged gargoyle in his true form.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical sources.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Fraz-Urb’luu can choose to succeed when he fails a saving throw.
Magic Resistance. He has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.
Undetectable. Divination magic cannot target him, magical scrying sensors cannot reveal him, and abilities that sense demons or fiends cannot detect him.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
Charisma (spell save DC 23). No material components.
At will. Alter Self (can become Medium when changing his appearance), Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Phantasmal Force.
3/day each. Confusion, Dream, Mislead, Programmed Illusion, Seeming.
1/day each. Mirage Arcane, Modify Memory, Project Image.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Fist attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (3d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Three legendary actions are available. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Spent actions return at the start of this creature’s turn.
Tail (1 action). Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the tail is grappled (escape DC 24) and restrained while grappled. The tail can hold only one creature at a time.
Phantasmal Killer (2 actions). Cast Phantasmal Killer without needing concentration.

gm.title: Lair
lines: Zoragmelok is a circular fortress of twisted towers and domes in Hollow’s Heart. Fraz-Urb’luu is CR 24 (62,000 XP) when encountered in his lair.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one option. The same option cannot be used two rounds in a row.
Move doors. Replace up to five doors within the lair with wall and open the same number of new doors in previously solid walls.
Simulacrum. Copy one humanoid within the lair as if by Simulacrum. The copy appears instantly, follows Fraz-Urb’luu’s commands, and is destroyed on the next initiative count 20.
Wave of anguish. Each creature he can see within the lair takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage if it fails a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Intelligent creatures within 1 mile of the lair often glimpse dead friends or comrades that disappear almost immediately.
Within 6 miles, warped roads and paths loop back on themselves and make travel difficult.
A humanoid that spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile must pass a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or gain a flaw from Madness of Fraz-Urb’luu. A successful save grants immunity to this effect for 24 hours.
These effects fade over 1d10 days after Fraz-Urb’luu dies.

gm.title: Madness of Fraz-Urb’luu
lines:
If a creature goes mad in the lair or within Fraz-Urb’luu’s line of sight, roll d100 for a flaw. It lasts until cured.
01–20. The creature hides the truth about its intentions and actions even when honesty would help.
21–40. Hallucinations and episodes of catatonia come and go.
41–60. The creature drifts into elaborate daydreams and has trouble telling them apart from actual memories.
61–80. The creature holds on to a belief even in the face of overwhelming evidence.
81–100. The creature’s perception of reality differs from everyone else’s, leading to violent delusions.

gm.title: Description
lines: Alecto, Megaera, and Tisiphone hunt penitents in Ravenloft. They tempt their target back into wrongdoing before resorting to murder.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: The sisters appear together and may approach in the guise of elderly human women. They lure a penitent with promises of divination and make three attempts to corrupt them again. If all three attempts fail, the sisters try to kill the penitent in public. In combat, use the individual scourges and spellcasting of Alecto, Megaera, and Tisiphone alongside the shared rules below.

gm.title: Fury shared rules
lines:
Printed source. Furies, pp. 79–80. The sisters appear together and speak all humanoid languages. They try three times to divert a target from atonement before trying to kill them in public.
Defenses. Damage reduction 15/good. Immune to paralysis, polymorph, and mind-affecting effects.
Scourge. The +3 scourge works like a whip that deals 1d4 lethal damage before modifiers. A Fury may substitute it for her claw attacks. Use the attack and ability damage listed for that sister. Rake (Ex) is +9 melee for 1d4 + 1 damage.
Alter Self (Sp). At will as a standard action, a Fury can take the form of an elderly human woman indefinitely. Caster level 10.
Breath Weapon (Su, 3/day). Fill one adjacent square with foul air. Apply stinking cloud as cast by an 8th-level sorcerer, with a DC 16 Fortitude save.
Find Penitent (Su). Furies can locate a target who seeks redemption at the invitation or embrace stage of corruption. The target cannot hide from them, even with magic.
Gaseous Death (Su). At 0 HP, a Fury and her scourge dissolve into smoke. Surviving sisters continue to fight, though the last survivor tries to flee. If a sister survives, the slain Furies return at full HP after 24 hours. To kill them permanently, all three must die within the same 24 hours and an Innocent must deal the killing blows. Their scourges remain after permanent death.
Weaknesses. A good cleric or a paladin can turn each Fury separately by invoking her true name. A turning attempt cannot destroy, rebuke, or command her. A Fury cannot deliberately harm a good creature except with her breath weapon.
